title: Chamber lifting and non-radial Dunkl multipliers
summary: We study non-radial Dunkl multipliers via chamber lifting. For an arbitrary finite reflection group $G$, the chamber lifting records all reflected values of a function and conjugates a multiplier into a finite matrix-valued operator on the chamber. If the dyadic matrix entries admit off-diagonal kernels satisfying the chamber $L^2$ Hörmander condition $\operatorname{CH}^2_{s,η}$ with $s>N_κ/2$, then the original multiplier is bounded on $L^p(\mathbb R^N,dω)$ for every $1 N_κ/2$ therefore imply $L^p$ boundedness, for all $1<p<\infty$, for a genuinely non-radial class of symbols.
